summary: Retested the iteration_4 fixes on backend and frontend at 375x667. Backend: 56/56 pytest pass in the full parallel suite, including the new test_silverpt_v5.py (DELETE measurements and chat-unread). All 6 requested features work: the web PDF prints through a hidden iframe with 'SILVER-PT' and 'Marco Rossi' in the content, window.print is not called on the main page, the iframe is removed and there are no page errors; the trainer home shows unread-badge-<cid> '2' after 2 client messages; measure-delete-button deletes the measurement in the UI and in the DB; progress charts have an offset y-axis (77-82 kg, 61-64), rounded labels, dd/mm/yy x labels and no empty message when body data exists; the chat header reads 'Chat · Marco Rossi' and the 3 messages stay visible while GET /chat returns 500; the profile save error shows in rgb(255,59,59). Found the cause of the repeated duplicate measurements: test_silverpt_api.py never deleted the measurements, plans and sessions it created on Marco Rossi. I fixed this with a teardown. Remaining issues are minor UI ones. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: The chart content is wider than the visible area (scrollWidth 332-370 vs clientWidth 268), and scrollToEnd scrolls it 11-29px. As a result the first x-label is cut off ('10/01/26' shows as '6', '01/11/26' as '11/26') and the first point sits under the y-axis. Fix: compute spacing from the real plot width (width - initialSpacing - endSpacing - yAxisLabelWidth) / (n-1), or use adjustToWidth/parentWidth, and drop scrollToEnd when the content fits. This also fills the full width the iteration_4 item asked for, which is still not fully done.
measure-delete-button deletes right away with no confirmation (one tap removes data for good).

err is only rendered inside ListEmptyComponent. When messages exist, a failed send or refresh shows nothing, and the typed text is already cleared by setText('') before the POST, so it is lost silently.

integration_issues.issue: src/client-hub.tsx does not use /api/chat-unread, so the client's hub-chat-button has no unread badge (part of the iteration_4 action item). Only the trainer list badge was implemented.

issues: The SVG chart labels in report.ts use date.slice(5) (mm-dd, e.g. '01-10'), while the app uses dd/mm/yy. Use the same dl() format.

action_items: Fix the clipped first x-label and points in the progress charts (spacing/width calculation plus scrollToEnd).
Optional: add a confirm step to measure-delete-button.
Show chat send/refresh errors when messages exist (e.g. an ErrorText above the input bar), and restore the text if the send fails.
Optional: unread badge on the client's hub-chat-button using /api/chat-unread.
Optional: use the dd/mm/yy label format in the PDF SVG charts.
critical_code_review_comments: The DELETE /api/measurements/{mid} permissions are correct: trainer allowed, client 403 when measurements are hidden and 200 when visible, nutritionist 403, 404 if already deleted, 401/403 without a token.
The /api/chat-unread counts are correct and reset when GET /chat is called.
report.ts: the web iframe print works. The 800ms setTimeout before print() may fire before the photo tags finish loading. Consider waiting for frame.onload or for the images to load.
